app.title: Systems Engineering Awareness
app.tagline: A classroom auction game about building the right vehicle for the mission.
chooser.heading: Choose your role
chooser.instructorDesc: Run the session: setup, auction, official results and debrief.
chooser.studentDesc: Plan your vehicle, track the auction and prepare your bid privately.
chooser.handoff: Each role keeps its own saved work in this browser tab. The apps do not connect: the instructor announces results aloud.
chooser.privacy: Use fictional team names only. Do not enter personal or operational information.
chooser.unknownRole: That link asked for an unknown role. Choose a role below.
about.title: About this game
about.body: SEA Game {version}. Original code and illustrations are MIT licensed. All values are instructional, not real equipment data. The game makes no network connections.
shell.storageOff: This browser tab cannot save automatically. Export a backup after every important change.
shell.saveFailed: The last change could not be saved in this tab. Export a backup now.
shell.badSave: The saved game in this tab could not be read, so the game started empty. The unreadable data was kept.
shell.backupHint: A backup contains only this role’s data. Keep it private.
backup.exported: Backup file requested: {file}. Check your downloads.
backup.exportFailed: The browser refused the download. Copy the backup text instead.
backup.copyHint: Select all of this text and save it in a file ending in .json.
backup.importSummary: This backup is for session {code}, phase: {phase}, {position}.
backup.importWarn: The game in this tab will be replaced. You can undo this until your next action.
backup.importedPaused: Backup imported. The open lot was paused for review.
backup.nothing: There is nothing to export yet.
newSession.title: Start a new session?
newSession.body: This clears the current game in this tab. Export a backup first if you may need it.
error.money: That amount is not valid. Use dollars, or dollars and cents, without signs or separators. Prices are the start price plus multiples of $50,000.
error.percent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 10000, with up to two decimals.
error.zero-cost: A percentage cannot be used while the purchase cost is $0. Enter an amount instead.
error.capability: A capability total is out of range.
error.mission: Choose a mission for every team first.
error.card: That card ID does not belong to this lot. Check the round, lot and card announced.
error.phase: That action is not available right now.
error.limit: This team already has 2 wins this round.
error.duplicate: That card or lot is already recorded.
error.stale: The offer changed before your click. Check the new amount and try again.
error.expired: Time is up. Add 30 seconds or close the lot.
error.reason: Enter a short reason (up to 120 characters).
error.ledger-limit: The ledger is nearly full, so this lot cannot be corrected again. Record a final result.
error.code: That session code is not valid. It looks like SEA3-T4-0A1B2C3D4E5F6071.
error.time: The timer value is not valid.
error.confirmation: Confirm your mission with the instructor first.
error.position: Choose a round from 1 to 7 and a lot from 1 to 10.
error.invalid-state: Something is inconsistent, so nothing was changed.
error.backup-format: This file is not a SEA Game backup that this version can read.
error.backup-role: This backup belongs to the other role. Import it in the matching role.
error.backup-session: The backup’s session code does not match its contents.
error.backup-size: That file is too large to be a SEA Game backup.
error.backup-json: That file is not readable JSON.
error.changed: Something changed while the dialog was open, so nothing was done. Please try again.
setup.title: Set up the session
setup.reveal.ROUND.hint: All ten lots of the current round show when the round starts.
setup.reveal.JIT.hint: Each lot appears when you reach it.
setup.secondsHint: 10 to 120. You can pause or add 30 seconds during a lot.
setup.codeHint: Write this code on the board. Each team enters it with its team number and mission.
practice.title: Practice lot (not scored)
practice.desc: Walk through one lot with the training card. Nothing here counts.
practice.done: Practice done. Teams now record the practice win in their app.
practice.student: Your instructor is demonstrating one practice lot. When they announce that Team 1 won, record the practice win.
practice.recorded: Practice win recorded. Nothing here counts.
planning.title: Assign missions
planning.hint: Confirm each team’s mission with them. Missions lock when the auction starts.
planning.start: Close planning and start the auction
planning.startBody: Missions lock for the rest of the game.
auction.bidHint: Click the team that bids. Each click accepts the next offer.
auction.unsoldBody: Team {n} is leading at {amount}. Record this lot as unsold anyway?
auction.correctHint: Use this if the winner or the price was wrong. The reason stays in the ledger.
auction.voidBody: The result stays in the ledger, marked void. Record a new result before moving on.
build.title: Results to reconcile
build.hint: Read each team’s purchases aloud or show this table so teams can check their records.
submit.title: Submissions
submit.publicHint: Teams calculate their profit privately and tell you. Do not project private entry.
submit.closeBody: Not submitted yet: {teams}. They will not be eligible for the award.
debrief.title: Results
debrief.noAward: No award: no team submitted a compliant build with a positive score.
debrief.why: The lowest bid per score point wins. Ties go to the lower bid, then the higher score.
debrief.closeBody: Results become read-only. Export a final backup.
closed.title: Session closed
closed.hint: Results are read-only. Export a final backup and keep it private.
join.title: Join the session
join.codeHint: From the board, for example SEA3-T4-0A1B2C3D4E5F6071.
splan.title: Plan your vehicle
splan.confirm: We confirmed this mission with the instructor
splan.changed: Mission changed. Confirm it with the instructor again.
splan.planHint: What must the vehicle do? Which capabilities matter most?
splan.risksHint: What could go wrong? Which penalties should you avoid?
splan.wtp: Most you would pay in total (dollars)
splan.wtpHint: A private guide, not a budget.
splan.guide: What each kind of card can give
splan.startedBody: Your mission locks for the rest of the game.
strack.noCard: Enter the card ID the instructor announces.
strack.finishBody: Only do this when the instructor has ended the auction. You can still correct purchases in the next step.
sbuild.title: Check your purchases
sbuild.hint: Compare with the instructor’s results. Fix recording mistakes only.
sbuild.removeBody: Only remove a card you recorded by mistake.
sbuild.done: Our records match. Continue to the bid
ssubmit.title: Prepare your bid
ssubmit.noScore: Your score is 0, so this build cannot win.
ssubmit.notCompliant: This build misses a minimum, so it cannot win.
ssubmit.tell: Tell the instructor privately: Team {n}, profit {amount}.
sdebrief.title: Debrief
sdebrief.closeBody: Do this after the instructor announces the results.
bay.title: Vehicle bay
bay.unavailable: 3D view unavailable on this device. The game works without it.
auction.keys: Keyboard: 1–9 and 0 accept a bid from Teams 1–10 · S sell · U no sale · O open · R reveal · N next lot · P pause or resume · E add 30 s.
app.unsupported: This browser is too old for this game. Use Windows 11 with a current version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
value.hint: Score it adds = your score minus your score without that card. A card can add 0 points and still be needed for a minimum.
bay.hint: Drag, or use the arrow keys, to turn the vehicle. Scroll or press plus and minus to zoom. Double-click to reset.
chooser.heroLabel: Recovery vehicle with winch, armour, radio, sensors and heavy-duty suspension
